questions.history: Execute the suite with two dynamic leaves.
questions.prediction: Both leaves should finish successfully on both revisions. Issue #5837 reports a separate NoTestsDiscoveredException on the enclosing suite before the fix. The merged suite should finish SUCCESSFUL once.
questions.basis: Two successful test-finished events with distinct IDs establish that tests ran. The pinned SuiteEngineTests separately requires both child successes and the suite success.
questions.refutation: Either child is missing or runs twice, or the merged suite still reports no tests.

questions.history: Return an empty stream from the only factory, with failIfNoTests=true.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should give zero test-leaf completions and a suite failure carrying NoTestsDiscoveredException.
questions.basis: The annotation defaults to requiring tests, and the pinned emptyDynamicSuiteFails case checks this policy.
questions.refutation: A fabricated child test, a successful suite, or a different suite exception.

questions.history: Wrap the same A and B factories’ dynamic leaves in a single DynamicContainer. Repeat with that container empty.
questions.prediction: The merge should report suite success for the two-leaf container, then NoTestsDiscoveredException for the empty one. Only A and B count as tests in the first run.
questions.basis: A container is registered dynamically too. Its node groups children, while the two finished leaves independently establish the count.
questions.refutation: An empty registered container makes the suite succeed, or adding a container around real tests makes the suite fail.
